tools.name: get-component-source

componentName.description: The name of the component (e.g., 'button', 'badge', 'tag') or 'utils' for the cn() helper or 'css' for styles

tools.name: get-component-accessibility
tools.description: Get accessibility guidelines and requirements for a myOperator UI component

tools.description: List design tokens (colors, spacing, radius, typography) from the myOperator UI design system

tools.description: Initialize a project for myOperator UI components (runs: npx myoperator-ui init)

cwd.description: Working directory to run the command in (defaults to current directory)

tools.name: install-component
tools.description:
Install myOperator UI components using natural language or component names.

Examples:
- "add button" - installs button component
- "add a login form" - installs text-field, button, checkbox
- "install button, input, and select" - installs multiple components
- "I need a data table with status badges" - installs table and badge

Runs: npx myoperator-ui add <component>

prompt.description: Natural language description or component name(s) to install. Examples: 'button', 'add a login form', 'table and badge'

cwd.description: Working directory to run the command in (defaults to current directory)

tools.name: get-installation-info
tools.description: Get installation instructions and npm package info for myOperator UI
